summary: Six comparable hero collectors informed original Regalia layout studies. Their principles are adapted to the actual ProjectG modes and rules; competitor artwork and screens are excluded.

games.name: Lost Sword
games.takeaway: Hero identity can persist while the player changes tasks.
patterns: Hero and growth controls share a stable workspace; do not make the player re-find the selected hero.
A shared gear bag can open next to current slots rather than replace the character screen.
Group mission rewards and requirements; give story reading a clear next action.
games.limits: Dated 2025 publisher guides in Traditional Chinese. Screenshot inspection does not verify the current Global client or live touch behavior.

games.name: Star Savior
games.evidence: Official dated updates Â· Korean publisher UI
games.takeaway: Show the reason for a task before all its supporting detail.
patterns: A restrained lobby leaves the character and next objective readable.
Growth and support lending benefit from consistent card hierarchy.
Short skill summaries can open timing detail on demand.
games.limits: Official 2026 update screenshots and text. Proposed/update layouts may differ from the installed client; no client session was exercised.

games.name: Idle Heroes
games.takeaway: A clear activity hub can organize many repeatable modes.
patterns: Keep mode names visible alongside their landmark imagery.
Show progression and the next reward before distant content.
Use a persistent destination structure rather than scattered anonymous icons.
games.limits: Historical secondary visual evidence, not verification of the November 2026 client. No current interaction claims are inferred.

sources.title: Gear guide: Equipment and Forge screenshots

games.name: Epic Seven
games.takeaway: Make equipment decisions against the current owner and loadout.
patterns: Place current and candidate equipment/stat changes in the same workspace.
Keep an explicit equip action after selection.
Preserve character identity while opening the equipment manager.
games.limits: December 2025 publisher images were inspected. A dated secondary mirror associated images with the original JavaScript-gated notice. Current client parity and click behavior are unverified.

games.name: BrownDust2
games.evidence: Official developer notes and update documentation
games.takeaway: Treat party preparation and farming as separate, named tasks.
patterns: Deployed heroes and the available bench can sit side by side with aspect filters.
A farming hub can show owned materials next to destinations.
A large lobby hero can coexist with a short, named navigation dock.
games.limits: 2025 official notes include Korean UI screenshots in English articles. Developer-note pixels may precede release; no live client test.

games.name: Princess Connect! Re:Dive
games.evidence: Official publisher guides and dated notices
games.takeaway: Let detail panels change while the core character context remains.
patterns: Keep the paper doll and owned gear context beside the inspected piece.
Show upgrade requirements and material-source reasons in the same decision.
Group settings into clear sections with labeled volume controls and reset.
games.limits: Official Korean guide images and Japanese notices span different regions/dates. Static evidence does not prove current cross-region parity or every tap result.
